name: TripoSplat
description: Single image to 3D via feed-forward Gaussian Splatting (up to 262k Gaussians). The Gaussians are reconstructed into a watertight, vertex-colored .glb mesh so they preview and export like any other Modly model. Fast, no diffusion-step blowup. By Tripo AI / VAST AI Research. Requires ~10GB VRAM.
author: Lightning Pixel

params_schema.label: Sampling Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion sampling steps. More steps = cleaner Gaussians but slower.

params_schema.label: CFG Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance strength. Higher = closer to the input image.

params_schema.label: Gaussians
params_schema.tooltip: Number of Gaussians to decode. More = denser point cloud and finer mesh detail.

params_schema.label: Mesh Detail
params_schema.tooltip: Poisson reconstruction depth used to turn the Gaussians into a mesh. Higher = sharper geometry but slower and more triangles.

params_schema.label: Max Faces
params_schema.tooltip: Target face count for mesh simplification after reconstruction. -1 to disable.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.
